Inference uses your browser’s local model. This app has no cloud fallback and sends no chat requests to an AI provider. Conversation history lasts for this page session only.

What does “no download” mean?

The website’s normal HTML, CSS, and JavaScript still load. Demo AI does not fetch model weights or start a session when a model needs downloading. It only requests a session after the browser reports the model as available. Browser-managed model updates and downloads outside this app remain under the browser’s control. This is not an unlimited-credit online model.
